scope: Saved neural layers compose inside the shared GPU output kernel; copied/coherent CUDA and Vulkan parity, exact historical mask membership, persistent asset storage and real full-size saved GFX/export conformance. Native Metal execution is covered by the required CI gate after push.

implementation.combined_parameters: Curve and retouch values appended to the existing parameter array; generated pixels and small layer data reuse the released slots.
implementation.composition_order: After retouch, curve and split toning; layers retain recipe order and evolving gap opacity.
implementation.selection: Exact CPU-generated integer row spans for context bounds, outer paint and fully weighted core; binary boundary search, no photo-sized mask.
implementation.single_asset_coherent_cuda: Borrow the existing Arc-owned RGBA allocation directly; no CPU/GPU pixel copy.
implementation.multiple_assets: Deduplicate and pack distinct assets once, then retain host/device storage until the visible asset set changes.
implementation.unsupported_limits: Keep existing parallel CPU composition if GPU storage or addressing does not permit fusion; core format/memory limits unchanged.
implementation.asset_errors: Validate identities and load every visible immutable asset before output.

receipt.scope: Full saved painted-layer render and every RGBA16 TIFF sample/profile check on one owned source; numerical export conformance, not physical display colorimetry

timing_scope: One release-process observation on a shared machine, after local checks; saved-layer timer includes first asset validation, span generation, source rendering and fused composition, not an isolated kernel latency.
memory_scope: Verifier temporarily holds base, expected CPU-composed and fused float rasters; not ordinary GUI/export or aggregate system memory.
limits: Floating-point asset interpolation/blending is numerically close, not bit-identical to CPU composition; all unpainted samples and opacity remain exact on the full GFX control.
Native Metal gate must complete for this commit; local default/combined builds are not evidence of physical Metal execution.
One real full-size edit and targeted controls do not establish general photographic model quality or full objective completion.
